name: Sergius Paulus
overview: Sergius Paulus was a Roman deputy described in Acts 13 as a prudent man who sought to hear the word of God when Paul and Barnabas arrived. Despite opposition from Elymas the sorcerer, Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, confronted Elymas, resulting in divine judgment that led Sergius Paulus to believe, astonished by the teaching of the Lord. This account highlights Sergius Paulus as an example of a Roman official who turned to faith in Christ through the powerful witness and authority of the gospel.
